notes: Stage 4 Model B_fast: control for the post-EGA LENGTHENING hypothesis. Identical to Model B except phase 2 keeps the cleavage 17 h cycle (no lengthening). The contrast B_fast vs B isolates what the 17 -> 24 h post-EGA lengthening contributes to the blastocyst counts. Expected: B_fast grows to ~5-6x Model B's 168 h count, demonstrating the lengthening factor matters.
